nodes.title: WINNING KLEIN 9B IDENTITY WORKFLOW
widgets_values:
# FLUX.2 Klein 9B Mitch Identity Studio v1

This is the selected production workflow from the nine-scene comparison. It creates a new whole-frame image with **FLUX.2 Klein Base 9B**, the protected **V3 step-1600 Mitch identity LoRA**, genuine native reference photographs, and **Smartphone Snapshot Photo Reality v13**.

- `Fast Turbo — 8 steps`: on by default after a production-node identity and visual pass
- Turbo order: rank-256 BF16 Turbo `1.0` → Mitch identity `0.90` → smartphone realism `0.25`
- Turbo sampling: 8 Euler steps, CFG `1.0`, `Flux2Scheduler`
- `Quality — 50 steps`: turn Fast Turbo off to omit that LoRA and restore the exact 50-step / CFG `4.0` path
- Output: `832 × 1216`
- Group profile: one frontal reference to prevent identity duplication
- Solo profiles: frontal plus one angle/body reference
- `Visible flattering enhancement`: on by default; turn it off for the previous exact natural-appearance prompt
- RTX 3090 only

Choose the profile that matches the scene, write the complete photograph, and queue. The enhancement asks for a recognizably same-person best-day treatment: roughly 3–5 years younger, slightly stronger jaw/chin and cheekbones, a slight confident closed-lip expression with every tooth covered, clearer natural eye catchlights and balanced eyelids, finer visible pores, tidier stubble, reduced fine-line emphasis, and a noticeable light bronze tan. Natural eye size, color, spacing, and gaze remain anchors alongside core face width, nose, mouth, ears, and hairline. Turbo changes the LoRA stack and sampling regime; the enhancement changes prompt conditioning only. This workflow has no source-scene img2img, face swap, identity pass, restoration, or sharpening. Important results still require full-size identity, anatomy, scene-detail, skin-tone, and bystander review.

nodes.title: KLEIN BASE 9B + V3 STEP-1600 LORA + GENUINE REFERENCES
widgets_values: A photorealistic vertical candid phone photograph. m1tch_person is the one foreground man, seated diagonally on a caramel curved leather sofa in a dark navy suit and open-collar white shirt. His expression is calm, with lips gently closed, jaw and cheeks relaxed, and eyes looking naturally toward the camera. His left arm rests along the sofa back, his right hand rests near his pocket, and his legs are crossed. Three unrelated friends stand behind him: a woman at image-left holding a red drink, a dark-haired man in a black shirt at center, and a woman in a sleeveless black dress at image-right. Their faces, hair, and ages are clearly distinct from Mitch and from each other. Warm amber lounge lighting, ordinary smartphone perspective, natural skin texture, complete visible arms and hands.
